purpose: Stable semantic geometry contract that every mesh strategy consumes before the winning mesh topology is selected.

fixed_geometry_topology.span_model: half-wing mirrored about the root/symmetry plane

station_order_root_to_tip.role: inner planform break / flat-root-panel outboard boundary

leading_edge.definition: front_x/front_y curve produced by planform builder, lifted by section geometry

trailing_edge.definition: rear_x/rear_y curve produced by planform builder, lifted by section geometry
trailing_edge.policy: as-built TE thickness remains governed by DECISION-0004; mesh may add a documented mesh-only floor only after evidence

root.definition: b0 plane, open half-model edge for pyHyp symmetry

tip.definition: b3 physical wingtip station; current cap4 closes the flat airfoil face

symmetry.definition: mirrored half-wing symmetry at root plane

airfoil_assignment.rule: step-function station resolver on span group boundaries

twist_dihedral_rules.twist: piecewise linear interpolation through b0/b1/b2/b3 station values
twist_dihedral_rules.dihedral: piecewise linear interpolation through station values with cumulative trapezoidal integration for z(y)

all_strategies: consume station IDs b0/b1/b2/b3 instead of rediscovering anonymous raw coordinates where possible
preserve LE, TE, root symmetry, tip, planform breaks, and elevon entities in boundary labels/manifests
record connectivity signature and region mapping per run
do not alter the prescribed physical OML to make meshing easier
mesh_strategy_requirements.S0_CAP4: map existing cap4 blocks to LE/TE/root/tip/elevon entities and preserve known weak regions in regional QC
mesh_strategy_requirements.S1_TIP_FIRST_SWEEP: use b3 tip station and ordered stations b2/b1/b0 for tip-to-root progression
mesh_strategy_requirements.S2_CROSS_FIELD_TIP: project generated tip blocks back to TIP surface and prove deterministic singularity/block graph
mesh_strategy_requirements.S3_STATION_SWEEP: anchor every sweep interval at b0/b1/b2/b3 plus elevon span boundaries where required
mesh_strategy_requirements.S4_ANALYTIC_MULTIBLOCK: derive control vertices from station, LE/TE, root, tip, and local chord/thickness semantics
mesh_strategy_requirements.S5_FROZEN_RBF: use the same b0/b1/b2/b3 and elevon landmarks as frozen RBF control correspondence

stage_00_findings.pinned_active_variable: dihedral_b1_deg has min=max=0.0 but remains in the sample contract; perturbation studies must treat it as pinned unless an ADR changes the flat-root-panel invariant.
known_limitations: Current mesh boundary-label contract still needs Stage 01 harness work to convert these semantic entities into per-strategy CGNS/PLOT3D boundary records.
Physical split-elevon CAD is disabled by default and excluded from neutral strategy selection per RUNBOOK Section 5.3.
stage_00_findings.audit_correction: Historical cap4 config is restored separately for reference reproduction; current geometry authority remains configs/geometry/bwb.yaml.
